---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature or improvement for Orbit Store
title: "[Feature] "
---

Please check existing issues first and keep each request focused
on one feature.

## What would you like?

Describe the feature or improvement.

## What problem would it solve?

Explain what you are trying to do and what is missing or difficult
in Orbit today.

## How should it work?

Describe the experience you would expect. You do not need to
provide a technical implementation.

## Where would you use it?

Native PS5 app / PS5 browser / Orbit Zero desktop / paired phone or computer / all

## Alternatives or workarounds

Optional: explain how you currently handle this, or other approaches
you have considered.

## Examples or additional context

Optional: add screenshots, relevant documentation or examples from
other apps.
